mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `warehouse_item`
user_id, farm_owner_id, inbound_operator_id, item_name, item_code, image_url, category, specification, unit, stock_qty, warning_qty, manufacturer, status, remark,
#{userId}, #{farmOwnerId}, #{inboundOperatorId}, #{itemName}, #{itemCode}, #{imageUrl}, #{category}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{stockQty}, #{warningQty}, #{manufacturer}, #{status}, #{remark},
mapper.update:
UPDATE `warehouse_item`
farm_owner_id = #{farmOwnerId}, inbound_operator_id = #{inboundOperatorId}, item_name = #{itemName}, item_code = #{itemCode}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, category = #{category}, specification = #{specification}, unit = #{unit}, warning_qty = #{warningQty}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark},
WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE `warehouse_item` SET is_deleted = 1, status = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT , iir.price AS initial_unit_price FROM `warehouse_item` wi LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = wi.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` fou ON fou.id = wi.farm_owner_id LEFT JOIN `user` iou ON iou.id = wi.inbound_operator_id LEFT JOIN `warehouse_record` iir ON iir.id = ( SELECT wr.id FROM `warehouse_record` wr WHERE wr.item_id = wi.id AND wr.record_type = 1 AND wr.status = 1 ORDER BY wr.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN `warehouse_record` lor ON lor.id = ( SELECT wr.id FROM `warehouse_record` wr WHERE wr.item_id = wi.id AND wr.record_type = 2 AND wr.status = 1 ORDER BY wr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN `user` lou ON lou.id = lor.operator_id WHERE wi.id = #{id} AND wi.is_deleted = 0
